targets.rawSql: WITH indoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric IN ('atmp', 'temperature') THEN value END) as temp FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), outdoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'temperature' THEN value END) as temp FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(i.bucket, o.bucket) as time, i.temp as "Indoor Temperature", o.temp as "Outdoor Temperature", (i.temp - o.temp) as "Temperature Delta" FROM indoor i FULL OUTER JOIN outdoor o ON i.bucket = o.bucket ORDER BY time

WITH indoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric IN ('pm02', 'pm25') THEN value END) as pm25 FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), outdoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'pm2_5' THEN value END) as pm25 FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(i.bucket, o.bucket) as time, CASE WHEN o.pm25 > 0.1 THEN i.pm25 / o.pm25 ELSE NULL END as "Indoor/Outdoor Ratio", i.pm25 as "Indoor PM2.5", o.pm25 as "Outdoor PM2.5" FROM indoor i FULL OUTER JOIN outdoor o ON i.bucket = o.bucket ORDER BY time

WITH indoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric IN ('pm02', 'pm25') THEN value END) as pm25 FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), outdoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'pm2_5' THEN value END) as pm25 FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(i.bucket, o.bucket) as time, i.pm25 as "Indoor PM2.5", o.pm25 as "Outdoor PM2.5" FROM indoor i FULL OUTER JOIN outdoor o ON i.bucket = o.bucket WHERE i.pm25 IS NOT NULL AND o.pm25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

panels.title: Temperature Lag Analysis (Outdoor Lead vs Indoor Response)

targets.rawSql: WITH outdoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'temperature' THEN value END) as temp FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), indoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric IN ('atmp', 'temperature') THEN value END) as temp FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT o.bucket as time, o.temp as "Outdoor Temp (T)", i.temp as "Indoor Temp (T)", i1.temp as "Indoor Temp (T+1h)", i2.temp as "Indoor Temp (T+2h)" FROM outdoor o LEFT JOIN indoor i ON o.bucket = i.bucket LEFT JOIN indoor i1 ON o.bucket = i1.bucket - INTERVAL '1 hour' LEFT JOIN indoor i2 ON o.bucket = i2.bucket - INTERVAL '2 hours' ORDER BY time

WITH paired AS (SELECT i.value as indoor, o.value as outdoor FROM (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric IN ('pm02', 'pm25') THEN value END) as value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) i INNER JOIN (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'pm2_5' THEN value END) as value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) o ON i.bucket = o.bucket WHERE i.value IS NOT NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL) SELECT corr(indoor, outdoor) as "value" FROM paired

WITH paired AS (SELECT i.value as indoor, o.value as outdoor FROM (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric IN ('pm02', 'pm25') THEN value END) as value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) i INNER JOIN (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'pm2_5' THEN value END) as value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) o ON i.bucket = o.bucket WHERE i.value IS NOT NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL AND o.value > 0.1) SELECT AVG(indoor / outdoor) as "value" FROM paired
